description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003-Direction No. 77-Coconut oil shall not be blended with any Other Oil/oils
categorisation: This gazette content contains a special direction issued under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003, which establishes a regulatory framework prohibiting the blending of edible coconut oil with other oils. This constitutes a regulatory matter under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
